clan.name: Moonlighters
clan.description: Can't fight the moonlight? TAKES 2!!!Well come and join us! Looking for active players TE onwards.. We are a guild of casual and friendly players looking to recruit active/semi active members to a guild which is fun to be in and also to help players grow. We take the Guild Expedition seriously we feel its worth it.Open to level 5 every week, nothing mandatory, but we all seem to best it ...322 wins1.9 up to 1.93 GB threads plus Non Proffit, 3 external 1.9 - with 1 , 1.95 thread available  and full ARC Bonus tooGbG Play to your style.with full build support built, we are very competitive in this field and stand tall with the best, attaining a solid Diamond play since coming straight through from Copper league where we started summer 2024, also attaining top game play and strategy with one of the most experienced Lead GbG players on EN7QI We are getting there and play it each season, our players are keen for this even the new version and again we have an experienced Qi lead player with tips and full support for you to enjoy again this fragment of the game..we have a tact already for easy play thereTop drawer advice from us, for Casual, Medium, or Fast growth as you desire here..all guidelines given from top players that are on hand to guide you with your game experienceWe dont like to leave anyone out in the cold, so if your advancement is semi Casual send us a mail and we can chat All Aspects of the competing game are open for your leisure or pleasureFor contacts, please send all messages,questions to Founders.Its that simpleEstablished : July 2024
